apps.name: dazzle-camera
apps.title: Camera
apps.about: Take photos and record videos with a Raspberry Pi camera module, with a live view to frame them. They are kept in your files, to see and share.

apps.name: dazzle-chat
apps.title: Chat
apps.description: Chat with others on your network in rooms
apps.about: Talk with others on the same network in rooms, without an account or the internet: anyone running Chat nearby can join.

apps.name: dazzle-develop
apps.title: Develop
apps.about: Write programs in Zig and run them on this computer: an editor beside the output, with the Zig compiler built in.

apps.name: dazzle-files
apps.title: Files
apps.about: Browse the files on this computer and on USB drives plugged into it: open them with the app that opens their kind, see photos, and make, rename, copy, move and delete files and folders.

apps.name: dazzle-data-logger
apps.title: Geppetto
apps.description: Record inputs from the GPIO pins
apps.about: Record what the GPIO pins read over time, from buttons, switches and sensors, and see it drawn as a chart as it comes in.

apps.name: dazzle-maps
apps.title: Globe
apps.description: Explore the Earth on a 3D globe
apps.about: Explore the Earth on a 3D globe: spin it, zoom in to countries and see their names and borders.

apps.name: motu
apps.title: Motu
apps.about: Build on a tropical atoll of blocks: shape the islands, build huts, paddle a canoe across the lagoon, and look out to sea with a telescope. Islands are kept between games, and friends on the same network can play on yours.

apps.name: dazzle-terminal
apps.title: Terminal
apps.about: Run command-line tools: look round the files, see what the system is doing, and try commands, in a terminal with its own shell.

apps.name: dazzle-text-editor
apps.title: Text Editor
apps.about: Write and edit plain text files: notes, lists, code and configuration. It opens text files from Files, and keeps what you write as you go.
